# Current hard boundaries
BOUNDARY tiny-host TCB: generic admission/identity/dependency/lifecycle/effects/events/BootLock only
BOUNDARY authority-sensitive providers are SYSTEM_PINNED and exact-identity BootLock-bound
BOUNDARY TRUSTED_IN_PROCESS is the only implemented alpha1 execution mode
BOUNDARY DURABLE events are reserved but unsupported in alpha1
BOUNDARY adapters/ and profiles/ are plans unless explicit executable evidence says otherwise
BOUNDARY release requires guarded final-main PREFLIGHT then PUBLISH plus postpublication verification
BOUNDARY PyPI, external-adapter conformance, untrusted-plugin sandboxing, production readiness, security certification, formal proof, and independent review are not implied by this source tree
